x: As of March 2025, Acharya Devvrat was Governor of Gujarat, Bandaru Dattatreya of Haryana (since July 2021) and Shiv Pratap Shukla of Himachal Pradesh, so A-1, B-3, C-2. Option A wrongly puts Dattatreya in Himachal (his post in 2019–21, not 2025). (Now Haryana's Governor is Prof. Ashim Kumar Ghosh, and Shukla is Governor of Telangana.)
